objects.description: No custom structs, enums, typedefs, or classes are defined in this header. It only provides inline constexpr overloads of std::bit_width for unsigned integer types when compiling with a pre-C++20 standard, and then includes gfwx_original.h. The functions are not data types. Therefore, there are no custom data types to document within this file.

functions.name: std::bit_width
functions.signature: inline constexpr int std::bit_width(unsigned int x)
functions.description: Returns the number of bits needed to represent the value x (i.e., floor(log2(x)) + 1 for x > 0; returns 0 if x == 0). This is a C++17 polyfill of C++20 std::bit_width provided in namespace std when building with __cplusplus < 202002L. Use to compute the effective bit-width of an unsigned int.
requirements: x must be an unsigned int (function is overloaded for specific unsigned types only).
If x == 0, the function returns 0; otherwise it returns a positive integer equal to the position of the highest set bit plus one.
Available from this header only when __cplusplus < 202002L; on newer standards, the standard library’s std::bit_width applies.
